title: 第619章 练功第618章 天予我柄裁苍生万般无道皆可杀
slug: 道爷斗法累了西幻炸个鱼怎么了
lines: 星辰诀修炼的难点，在于如何在保持身体机能正常的情况下增加肉身密度。
又不是混元珠，不需要在意它有没有吃好睡好，直接把材料往里怼就完事了，肉身上的强化需要慎重，一个不小心就容易把自己搞死。
从海古那边交易来的炼体大药便是这般用途。
说起来这趟交易还是陈昭亏了，七品炼丹炉的价值可不只是送些人或者一些丹药能媲美的，不过也算了，反正这个七品丹炉也是陈昭从张老三那边捡来的，没花钱，用来报偿渊剑宗的恩情也是恰当的。
至于海古反悔？陈昭是一点不担心。
七品炼丹炉的诱惑巨大，若不是海古自知打不过陈昭，当时早就出手抢夺了，现在用来作为交易的筹码绝对是够够的，他绝不会冒险背刺。
也不必担心钟凛反水，那个女人就算不帮陈昭，按照她的性格，也会以此为要挟狠狠敲诈海古一番，更别提显示地址的卡片被陈昭下了标记，只有海古的灵力才能解锁。
嘛，也没有百分百确信啦，不过反正陈昭还能回去，若是这俩人背弃誓言，那就只能口他们全家了。
【不要风轻云淡的说出这么恐怖的话啊喂！】
走出平时待着的火柴盒，陈昭检查了一下附近的信息终端，并没有来自机甲星的消息，看来是无事发生，就不再关注。
来到穹顶的堆放货区，这里已经摞上了好几座山的钢卷。
不断有造型奇特的异虫将新生产出来的钢卷从生产线上搬运过来存放。
由于机甲界的自动化水平还不是特别发达，所以这类运输维护的工作便被陈昭交给了异虫来解决。
反正异虫是宇宙种族，在真空也能生存，饿了吃点炼制矿剩下来的废渣。
你问水？
其实月1的地壳里含有不少水分，推测是当初前文明将含水彗星投掷向机甲星时aoe到的，如今被陈昭用于电离制取氧气，供穹顶下的钢铁厂冶炼。
工业废水便直接交由异虫处理，陈昭随便找了个地方挖了个坑，废水就都倾倒在里边，逐渐形成了一个小湖，周围时常聚集着不少前来补充水分的异虫。
对于流浪在宇宙中，时常要靠捕获太空中稀薄尘埃作为物质补充的异虫一族来说，这工业废水还是太有营养了。
稍稍估算了一下，陈昭离开的这些时日，月1工业基地生产出了大约五十万吨的金属材料，对于这么个太空环境下的自动工厂已经算是很不错的成绩了。
【这不是钢卷，这是筑基极品法宝，天钢碾身卷】
“你够了”
挥手将货场上的这些金属收入储物袋，让异虫继续干活，陈昭则飞到穹顶下的一处空闲地带，比划了一阵后，将储物戒中的那尊巨大九品丹炉给放了出来。
得亏当时给穹顶安置的还算高大，这九品丹炉的高度险些顶到天花板。
以防万一，陈昭还是又给地面挖深了不少，并且给丹炉搭建了一个防护用的外框架。
有这尊从血云宗薅来的九品丹炉，之前那个七品给海古就给了吧。
将诸多药材投入丹炉之中，在灵力的驱使下，都不需要陈昭操作，丹炉便开始自动处理起各类药材，为陈昭省了好大一份精力。
content_en:
The difficulty in practicing the Star Art is how to increase the density of the physical body while maintaining normal body functions.
It's not a Hunyuan Pearl. You don't need to worry about whether it eats well and sleeps well. You can just pour the materials into it and it's done. You need to be careful when strengthening the physical body. You can easily kill yourself if you are not careful.
The body-refining medicine traded from Haigu is used for this purpose.
Speaking of which, Chen Zhao lost money in this transaction. The value of the seventh-grade alchemy furnace is not comparable to that of giving away some people or some elixirs. But forget it, anyway, Chen Zhao picked up this seventh-grade alchemy furnace from Zhang Laosan without spending any money. It is appropriate to use it to repay the kindness of Yuanjian Sect.
As for Haigu going back on his word? Chen Zhao was not worried at all.
The temptation of the seventh-grade alchemy furnace was huge. If Haigu hadn't known that he couldn't beat Chen Zhao, he would have snatched it away. Now it would definitely be enough as a bargaining chip, and he would never take the risk of backstabbing.
There is no need to worry about Zhong Lin betraying him. Even if that woman does not help Chen Zhao, according to her character, she will use this as a threat to blackmail Hai Gu. Not to mention that the card showing the address has been marked by Chen Zhao and can only be unlocked by Hai Gu's spiritual power.
Well, I'm not 100% sure, but Chen Zhao can still go back anyway. If these two people break their oath, they will have no choice but to kill their whole family.
[Don’t say such horrible things so calmly! 】
Walking out of the matchbox where he usually stayed, Chen Zhao checked the nearby information terminal. There was no news from the Mecha Star. It seemed that nothing happened, so he stopped paying attention.
Arriving at the storage area of ​​the dome, several mountains of steel coils were already stacked here.
There are constantly strange-looking insects carrying newly produced steel coils from the production line for storage.
Since the level of automation in the mecha world is not particularly developed, Chen Zhao left this kind of transportation and maintenance work to Zerg.
Anyway, the zerg are a cosmic race and can survive in a vacuum. When they are hungry, they will eat the waste left over from the refining mine.
You ask about water?
In fact, the crust of Moon 1 contains a lot of water. It is speculated that it was obtained when the former civilization threw water-containing comets towards the Mecha star. It is now used by Chen Zhao to ionize it to produce oxygen for smelting in the steel plant under the dome.
The industrial wastewater was directly handed over to the zerg for treatment. Chen Zhao dug a hole somewhere and dumped the wastewater inside, gradually forming a small lake, surrounded by many zerg that came to replenish water.
For the Zerg clan that wanders in the universe and often relies on capturing the thin dust in space as material supplement, this industrial wastewater is still too nutritious.
After a little calculation, in the days since Chen Zhao left, the Yue 1 Industrial Base produced about 500,000 tons of metal materials, which is already a very good result for an automatic factory in such a space environment.
[This is not a steel scroll, this is the ultimate magic weapon for foundation building, the Tiangang Body Rolling Scroll]
"You are enough"
After waving his hand to put the metals in the storage bag into the storage bag and letting the Zerg continue working, Chen Zhao flew to a free area under the dome, and after gesticulating for a while, he released the huge ninth-grade alchemy furnace in the storage ring.
Fortunately, the dome installed at that time was quite tall, and the height of the ninth-grade alchemy furnace almost reached the ceiling.
Just in case, Chen Zhao dug a lot deeper into the ground and built a protective outer frame for the alchemy furnace.
There is this ninth-grade alchemy furnace brought from the Blood Cloud Sect. The previous seventh-grade pill furnace should be given to Haigu.
Many medicinal materials were put into the alchemy furnace. Driven by spiritual power, the alchemy furnace began to automatically process various medicinal materials without Chen Zhao's operation, saving Chen Zhao a lot of energy.
